workspace.description: Norwegian municipal booking and resource management system - Master Roadmap

projects.name: Digilist Master Roadmap
projects.description: Complete implementation roadmap for the Digilist Platform with 8 phases covering core architecture, SDK foundation, multi-tenant isolation, API layer, infrastructure automation, production launch, and continuous improvement.

milestones.name: P0 - Core Architecture & Constraints
milestones.description: Establish non-negotiable architectural patterns: SDK-first, audit-first, RBAC, RFC 7807, Designsystemet guardrails, and zero-transformer contract-first principles.

milestones.name: P1 - SDK Foundation
milestones.description: Build enterprise-grade @digilist/client-sdk with 24+ services, React Query hooks, WebSocket realtime, and TypeScript types.

milestones.name: P2 - Multi-Tenant Isolation
milestones.description: Implement kommune-level tenant isolation with tenant context, data partitioning, and cross-tenant security.

milestones.name: P3 - API Layer
milestones.description: Build Fastify API with business logic, Drizzle/Postgres persistence, audit logging, and RFC 7807 error handling.

milestones.name: P4 - UI Facade & Design System
milestones.description: Implement @xala/ds facade layer with Designsystemet re-exports, theme system, and component hierarchy (Primitives, Composed, Blocks, Shells).

milestones.name: P5 - Audit & Compliance
milestones.description: Ensure all mutations are auditable with required fields: who, what, when, tenantId, ip/ua. Implement audit service and logging.

milestones.name: P6 - Infrastructure & Deployment
milestones.description: Configure Turborepo pipelines, pnpm workspaces, Vite builds, SSL certificates, and deployment automation for web, backoffice, and minside apps.

milestones.name: P7 - Continuous Improvement
milestones.description: Ongoing optimization, performance monitoring, testing automation, and documentation updates.

issues.title: Enforce SDK-first rule - no direct fetch/axios in apps
issues.description:
All API calls must use @digilist/client-sdk. Direct fetch(), axios, or graphql calls are forbidden in apps/. If SDK lacks a method, report gap - do NOT bypass.

Verification:
- Scan apps/** for axios, node-fetch imports
- Verify @xala/client-sdk usage in all API-calling components

issues.title: Implement SDK session continuity and auth refresh
issues.description:
SDK must maintain session state across page reloads and handle token refresh automatically. Use initializeClient() for configuration.

Acceptance criteria:
- Session persists across navigation
- Token refresh happens before expiry
- Auth errors trigger re-authentication flow

issues.title: Implement tenant context propagation in SDK
issues.description:
All SDK service calls must include tenantId. Tenant context must be set at initialization and propagate to all API requests.

Acceptance criteria:
- tenantId included in all API headers
- Cross-tenant data access blocked at SDK level
- Tenant switching handled gracefully

issues.title: Enforce Designsystemet guardrails - @xala/ds only
issues.description:
Apps must import from @xala/ds only, never directly from @digdir/*. ESLint rules must block direct Designsystemet imports.

Verification:
- Scan apps/** for @digdir/* imports
- Verify eslint-config/rules enforce import restrictions

issues.title: Implement audit logging for all mutations
issues.description:
Every state mutation must be auditable. Required audit fields: who, what, when, tenantId, ip/ua. If action is not logged, block implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- auditService captures all mutations
- Audit trail legally compliant
- WebSocket realtime audit events working

issues.title: Configure production deployment pipelines
issues.description:
Set up Turborepo pipelines, deployment scripts for web/backoffice/minside, SSL certificate management, and environment configuration.

Deliverables:
- pnpm deploy:web, deploy:backoffice, deploy:minside
- pnpm deploy:all for full deployment
- SSL certificate automation
